sql:
SELECT ProductName, UnitPrice, UnitCost, (UnitPrice - UnitCost) * 100.0 / nullif(UnitPrice, 0) AS ProfitMarginPct
FROM retail.DimProduct
WHERE UnitPrice IS NOT NULL AND UnitPrice > 0
ORDER BY ProfitMarginPct DESC
LIMIT 10
